description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EntityNotFoundException' that extends a base exception 'SimpleBankingGlobalException' for handling entity not found errors in the banking application.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a requested entity was not found in the database, extending the global banking exception class.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message and an error code indicating entity not found.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom error message while defaulting the error code to entity not found.
